_permissions_note: Do NOT hand-maintain a rule list here. The canonical allow/ask/deny rule set (including the Windows PowerShell mirror of every Bash rule) lives at ../../permissions/claude-settings.permissions.json — merge THAT file's permissions block into your live ~/.claude/settings.json. The skeleton below only shows the shape; an earlier version of this template restated a weaker subset of the rules and drifted from canon.
_relay_hooks_note: OPTIONAL relay hook surfaces — requires a relay, see ../../docs/human-in-the-loop.md. These are commented-out placeholders: rename '_hooks_relay_example' to real entries merged into 'hooks' above once your relay exists. Three surfaces: (1) PreToolUse Bash (add '|PowerShell' on Windows) = approval gate; (2) PreToolUse AskUserQuestion = question redirect to phone; (3) Stop = turn-end ping. Timeouts must be >= your relay adapter's answer window (reference: 86400 s) or late phone answers are stranded.
